user_question: Calculate the mean absolute elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for Bellefonte.

outputs.summary: The worker failed because input_1 could not be opened (E_WORKER_TRANSPORT: No such file or directory), and this task produced no output artifact. Retry after revising the invocation to bind the available input_1 artifact correctly and resample it to the specified target grid.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate the mean absolute elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for Bellefonte.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve Bellefonte analysis boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a polygon boundary covering Bellefonte for spatially restricting the elevation comparison.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available Bellefonte polygon boundary suitable for GeoPackage-based zonal statistics. Treat the returned dataset as a candidate and validate its spatial coverage, geometry, CRS, and format at runtime.

workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation surface
workflow_steps.purpose: Resample the second elevation raster to the first raster's 30 metre grid so cell-wise arithmetic is valid.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample the raster in input_2 to the grid of input_1, including the target 30 metre resolution and matching grid alignment, extent, and CRS. Do not alter the analytical values beyond the required resampling.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate absolute elevation difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the cell-wise absolute difference between the two aligned elevation surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate the absolute value of the difference between input_1 and aligned_surface_2. Preserve the overlapping valid-data area and produce a GeoTIFF raster of absolute elevation differences.

workflow_steps.title: Summarize mean absolute difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean absolute elevation difference over Bellefonte.
workflow_steps.instructions: Run zonal statistics using bellefonte_zone as the polygon zone and absolute_difference_raster as the value raster. Return the mean statistic for the Bellefonte zone, excluding nodata cells and cells outside the valid overlap of the two elevation surfaces.

workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation surface to first surface grid
workflow_steps.purpose: Make the second elevation surface cell-wise compatible with input_1 for absolute-difference calculation.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample aligned_surface_2 to exactly match the observed grid of input_1: CRS EPSG:26918, dimensions 1161 by 1148, 30 metre resolution, transform [30.0, 0.0, 238087.3824011362, 0.0, -30.0, 4543387.006183241, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0], and matching extent and grid origin. Emit the result with the stable role aligned_surface_2.

input_1 and aligned_surface_2 must use compatible CRSs for raster calculation.
input_1 and aligned_surface_2 must have compatible raster grids for cell-wise absolute-difference calculation.

absolute_difference_raster and bellefonte_zone must have compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
bellefonte_zone must contain valid polygon geometry suitable for zonal statistics.
The zonal statistics output must contain the runtime-grounded mean statistic field for the Bellefonte zone.
The final mean absolute elevation difference summary must be emitted as a CSV table.
